admissions.title: Undergraduate Admissions | Khalifa University
quotes: *Applicants must be awarded the full IB Diploma with six HL/SL subjects (excluding Islamic Education)
*Minimum score of 4 in each subject – with a total of 24 points.
Minimum five IGCSE/GCSE (O-Level) subjects with grade C or above.
Mathematics (Mandatory) (minimum Grade C) • Two of the following: Physics, Chemistry, and/or Biology (minimum Grade C)
Mandatory English Proficiency Test Score IELTS Academic 6.0 OR TOEFL iBT 79
Shortlisted applicants will be required to take KU Admission Tests
Applicants must have graduated from high school no later than two years before the current year (i.e., not before 2023).

admissions.threshold: Mechanical Engineering: full IB Diploma (six HL/SL subjects), at least 4 in each subject and 24 points in total, including Mathematics and Physics. Shortlisted applicants take KU's admission tests; high-school graduation no earlier than 2023.

Mechanical Engineering: five IGCSE/GCSE subjects at grade C or above, plus three AS/A Level subjects at grade C or above including Mathematics and Physics. Shortlisted applicants take KU's admission tests; high-school graduation no earlier than 2023.
